deadlines.label: Fall2027 application
deadlines.note: Fee-waiver applications due one week earlier.

english.note: University minimums; PTE65 also accepted. Degree with GPA3.0 and solely English instruction may exempt; foreign institution verified via WHED. Program may require higher scores.

applicationFee.note: $135 US citizens/permanent residents/undocumented; $155 international. Central waivers exclude international applicants.

documents: Unofficial transcripts; English translation if needed
requirements.note: University bachelor-equivalent and GPA3.0 minimum. Quantitative/computational track record expected; complementary biological/physical sciences, computing or mathematics preparation. Additional educational experiences optional.

funding.note: Most first-year students receive tuition/fees, health insurance and stipend; subject to good standing. International support may combine faculty research funds and fellowships; external funding encouraged.
